scope.full_page_resolution: 72 dpi; 640 × 840 pixels, one PDF page per image. All 1/3/4/9/10 pages in all six chapters were opened individually in both languages.
scope.previous_architecture_inspection: qa/visual-diagrams-15-20.json contains inspection of all 12 original 1000 × 700 architecture renders.
scope.revision_note: The final PDF hashes are bound to the previous visual approval through byte-identical hashes for all 60 recorded page PNGs and all 12 recorded contact sheets. Original PDF hashes remain under original_visually_reviewed_pdfs. No new inspection is claimed.

observations: Source header crops remain in their original Portuguese in both editions; the surrounding explanation is translated. Capture title and public status can be read at page scale.
Architecture labels, official technology tiles and numbered edge legends fit. Original diagrams were also checked separately at native resolution; no connector crosses a node.
Code pages contain dense but readable monospaced excerpts with visible indentation and full right-hand line endings. The full executable source remains linked.
Financial tables and assumptions are visible without collisions. Evidence amounts and hypothetical economics remain separated in the sampled pages.
Several prose and roadmap pages intentionally leave generous lower white space. They are not blank, truncated or unexpectedly spilled onto another page.
limits: This report approves visual layout for cases 15–20 only: 156 pages at overview scale and the specified 60 full-page samples. It does not claim all 640 pages were personally inspected by this reviewer.
Final-revision equivalence was checked through recorded SHA-256 values. This resumption performed hash verification only; it did not edit content or rerun tests.

nochangeverification.method: SHA-256 byte comparison against hashes captured during the previous actual visual inspection. No new visual inspection and no tests rerun.
nochangeverification.scope_precision: 60 individual page PNGs are byte-identical. Twelve contact sheets covering all 156 chapter pages are byte-identical at the previously reviewed overview scale; this does not claim full-resolution hash comparisons for the other 96 page PNGs.
